operator_notes: First real run against funded esmeralda wallet (209,023 tXTM, 670,316 blocks scanned). External wallet, not spawned. Validates harness gRPC contract and surfaces a meaningful wallet-pain finding.

rescan_bench.observed_behavior: scanned_height dropped from 670316 to 665390, climbed back to 670316 in ~10s

wallet_pain_findings.finding: RescanWallet(from_height=0) does NOT reset scan to genesis
wallet_pain_findings.evidence: scanned_height floor was 665,390 (only ~5,000 blocks below tip), not 0
wallet_pain_findings.impact_on_spec_S2_S3_S6_S7: Genesis rescan via this RPC is impossible. Spec authors (SWvheerden via roadhero, 2026-05-29) confirm: genuine genesis rescan requires changing the encoded birthday in the seed and reinitialising the wallet. The harness must use that path, not RescanWallet.
wallet_pain_findings.consequence_for_harness: src/scenarios/{s2,s3,s6,s7}.rs currently call mode.rescan_from(0) and poll until scanned_height >= tip. Against a wallet already at tip, this returns near-instantly with a fake-fast throughput number. Mode 1's rescan_from must be reimplemented as: stop wallet -> rewrite encoded birthday -> reinit wallet DB -> restart -> poll scanned_height from 0 to tip.

wallet_pain_findings.finding: GetState's WalletStateResponse field shape in our initial proto did not match the running wallet
wallet_pain_findings.evidence: GetState returned RPC error until we replaced WalletStateResponse{is_started,is_bootstrapped,height_of_longest_chain,scanned_height} with GetStateResponse{scanned_height,balance,network,has_done_initial_validation}
wallet_pain_findings.impact: Anyone writing a third-party gRPC client off the wallet.proto docs will need to use the current proto. Confirmed by re-reading applications/minotari_app_grpc/proto/wallet.proto in tari-project/tari.
